item.title: Any source of threat against Iran anywhere in world will be legitimate target: Top commander
item.description: General Heydari says the Iranian Armed Forces are fully prepared to respond to any hostile action without geographical boundaries.

item.title: Iranian researcher develops solid polymer electrolyte for next-generation calcium-ion batteries
item.description: The study explores the potential of calcium as an alternative charge carrier in next-generation energy storage systems.

item.title: Iran’s $290bn legal offensive: A battle to make US pay for decades of war crimes against Iranians
item.description: Iran’s judiciary has issued judgments totaling more than $290 billion against the United States, seeking accountability for decades of aggression, war crimes and destruction through an expanding legal campaign.

item.title: IRGC Navy vows revenge for Iranian sailors martyred during US-Israeli aggression
item.description: The IRGC Navy has paid tribute to the martyred sailors of the warships Joshan, Sahand, Sabalan, and Dena.

item.title: Iran to enhance Navy with advanced maritime defense systems: Defense minister
item.description: Akhlaghi stresses that the Defense Ministry is deploying its capabilities to implement the Leader’s directives and strengthen the country’s defense capabilities.

item.title: Iran's asset monetization hits 37 trillion tomans in five months
item.description: The government introduces new financial toolkits and decentralizes transaction approvals to provinces to accelerate infrastructure financing without relying on oil revenues.

item.title: Iran's fisheries exports surge over 50% as sector defies wartime pressures
item.description: Head of Iran Fisheries Organization highlights record shrimp harvest and massive private sector investment.

item.title: US senator calls on Congress to defund illegal war on Iran
item.description: US Senator Tammy Duckworth has announced she will vote against any government funding package that does not include an amendment to defund offensive military operations against the Islamic Republic until Congress provides explicit authorization.

item.title: IRGC Navy: Two illicit oil tankers explode near Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The IRGC Navy announced on Friday night that one tanker struck a naval mine near the entrance to Oman’s Khasab Port, while another exploded and caught fire along an unauthorized route east of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran Navy: Efforts to break US naval blockade underway
item.description: Rear Admiral Shahram Irani said Iran’s armed forces successfully halted the enemy’s advance at sea, keeping it at a distance in the Arabian Sea and northern Indian Ocean.

item.title: Iran claim gold, silver and bronze at Astana 2026 World Para Taekwondo Grand Prix Final
item.description: Amirmohammad Haghighatshenas won gold, while Maryam Abdollahpour and Zahra Rahimi secured silver and bronze, respectively, as Iran collected three medals at the Astana 2026 World Para Taekwondo Grand Prix Final.

item.title: US naval base in Bahrain faces uncertain future after Iranian strikes cause $400m damage
item.description: The US Naval Support Activity (NSA) base in Bahrain is facing an uncertain future after sustaining heavy damage in Iranian retaliatory strikes following the launch of the US-Israeli war of aggression against Iran in late February.

item.title: Protests erupt in Puerto Rico’s capital as living standards deteriorate
item.description: Retirees, university students, bus drivers, and others joined the protest organized by some 30 groups ranging from unions to religious organizations.

item.title: Saudi airstrikes destroy fuel tank, target telecommunications network in Sa'ada
item.description: Citizens demanded an end to the Saudi aggression and the lifting of the siege imposed on Yemen, expressing their support for the position of the Yemeni armed forces in confronting the ongoing attacks.

item.title: Bolivian workers march in La Paz against diesel price hike and education plan
item.description: Thousands of Bolivian workers, teachers and miners march into La Paz demanding repeal of diesel price decree and education policies.
